summary: The live first-party gates cannot execute on this machine: the installed Win32 binding seam is 0.2.1-rc.3 while the shipped fence is qualified against 0.2.1-rc.2, so every worker refuses at pre-create with kernel-drift.

blocker.refusalMessage: the Win32 binding seam reports drift: resolved 0.2.1-rc.3 against qualified 0.2.1-rc.2

provenance.conclusion: the runtime moved AFTER Host-S1R qualified against it; this stage did not change the runtime and did not change the qualified version

affected.cause: every gate that boots a real worker refuses at pre-create

whyNotWorkedAround: Raising qualifiedVersion to match the installed runtime would assert a qualification that was never performed, which is the false positive the stage forbids.
Downgrading the installed runtime would change the user global installation, which the stage forbids.
Disabling the drift check would remove the protection it exists to provide.
requiredToProceed: Reinstall the runtime at 0.2.1-rc.2, or perform a fresh first-party qualification of the fence against 0.2.1-rc.3 and move the pinned qualifiedVersion in a separate authorized stage.
